Name: Steins Gate - Makise Kurisu Abigail Mod (CP)
Author: L1ttl3F00t
Description:
[left][u][size=5] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿Install[/size]
[/u][font=Georgia][color=#ffffff][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install the latest version of Content Patcher.[/url]﻿
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Tweak the config to your liking
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][/color][/font][/left][font=Georgia][color=#ffffff]
[/color][/font][font=Georgia]
[font=Georgia][color=#ffffff][u][size=5][center]Config Options[/center][/size][/u][u]
[/u][/color][/font][/font][font=Georgia][list]
[*][i][font=Georgia][color=#ffffff][size=3]EnableMod:[/size][/color][/font][/i]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=2]
﻿﻿﻿Replaces Abigail's sprites & portraits and changes her name to Kurisu (the same basic functionality as the original .xmb mod from MahoHiyajo).
[/size][/font][b]
[/b][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#ffffff][size=3][i]isTsundere:[/i] [/size][/color][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia] ﻿﻿Changes the elements of her character's [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:NPC_data]disposition [/url]as follows (manners and social anxiety will influence some of her generic dialogue).
[size=2] -﻿[/size][size=2][color=#ffffff]"true" sets m[/color]anners to "rude" and social anxiety to "shy"
﻿-[color=#ffffff]"false" sets m[/color]anners and social anxiety to "neutral"[/size][/font]
[font=Georgia]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#ffffff][size=3][i]DkPepper:[/i][/size][/color][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][i]
[/i][/font] [font=Georgia]﻿Replace "Joja Cola" with "Dk Pepper"
[size=2] ﻿-[/size][size=2]"standard" will change only the item name and description
﻿-"boosted" will give it a +1 speed boost (for the same duration as Coffee)
﻿-"no" will not change the Joja Cola at all[/size][/font]
[font=Georgia]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#ffffff][size=3][i]ChangeGiftTaste:[/i] [/size][/color][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia] ﻿ ﻿
﻿Update her gift tastes to be more suitable for Kurisu's character and changes her responses to receiving gifts.
﻿Her responses differ slightly depending ﻿on how you set "isTsundere".[/font]
[font=Georgia]

You can tweak her gift-reception responses as you please in content.json, just find the section that will run based on your selections made in config (look for the "When:" at the bottom of each section) and change the dialogue bits to your liking.  Same goes for the properties of the Joja Cola (item ID 167)- see the links for more details on making these changes.


[u][size=5][center]Compatibility[/center][/size]
[/u][list]
[*]Not compatible with other mods which use Content Patcher to override Abigail's sprites/portraits
[*]I don't know of other incompatibilities, please post them if any come up
[/list]




[u]References:[/u]
https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Category:Modding
https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Object_data
https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Gift_taste_data
https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:NPC_data


[/font][font=Georgia]


I did not have any role in creating the artwork for the images used, aside from the tiny edit for the alternate sprite sheet.
The original .xmb version of the mod from MahoHiyajo is available [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2214]here[/url]﻿.
[/font]
